policy.basis: Virtual cold-control ABI: documented QCE5.3.1 register encoding; newly defined non-MTI BAM marker3; primary SM8250 eight-channel/two-EE topology; no crypto/command-descriptor execution; full candidate002 rationale retained.

cnfg_derivation.meaning: Keep the complete source-defined workaround/configuration word except its command-descriptor enable. The change is an explicit virtual unsupported-feature policy. No source or firmware is claimed to have written this final word on the physical tablet.
cnfg_derivation.scope_of_retained_flags: These flags define a frozen control configuration only. No descriptor engine executes their transfer-time behavior in this candidate.

cold_consumer_consequences: The vendor major5 check succeeds for the declared5.3.1 source ABI. The version-only probe initially sets no_get_around=true, but no algorithm capability bit is set.

First shared-BAM registration reads CNFG once. With CMD_ENABLE0 it records support_cmd_dscr=false and explicitly clears this first client no_get_around=false. Remote management is independently required by the actual shared DT property.

A second qce_open reads QCE version/engines again. qce_sps_get_bam finds the existing physical-BAM registration, copies support_cmd_dscr=false and returns before reading CNFG or clearing no_get_around. Thus this second client may retain its version-derived no_get_around=true.

Both clients omit qce_setup_cmdlistptrs because support_cmd_dscr=false; IOVEC/result-buffer preparation and setup_dummy_req remain RAM-only. There is no CD0-specific direct QCE register write or submit in the public cold qce_open path.
Both clients still configure their producer and consumer BAM pipes using the same shared4K EE0 sequence. The complete cold-control configuration remains required.

qce_hw_support hardcodes sha_hmac,cmac,aes_xts,bam,aes_ccm=true and does not derive them from ENGINES. ENGINES0 disables the OTA bit test but cannot suppress these software declarations. no_get_around selects max_request (first client1, cached client may use MAX_QCE_BAM_REQ). These are driver software assumptions, not implemented model capabilities.

The pinned manager source has no test-table match for the actual prefixed algorithm/driver names. That source registration path performs no crypto test. It is neither a successful cryptographic self-test nor a proof of original-kernel manager bytes.

Later explicit requests remain unsupported. With command descriptors disabled they may attempt direct QCE configuration before a BAM doorbell; the first omitted register or submission rejects atomically. No success/completion is fabricated.

identity_choices.rationale: Encode the explicit vendor5.3.1 software ABI using independently matching version bitfields. No physical revision or working CCM claim.
All algorithm/engine-selection, CE pipe-set and AXI beat fields arezero because no crypto datapath accepts work. BAM control topology is separate. No guest algorithm support is promised.

identity_choices.classification: virtual supported-subset policy derived from source initializer
identity_choices.rationale: Use upstream explicit default0x0ffff004, clearing only CMD_ENABLE because command descriptors are unsupported. This is a new virtual configuration, not an observed secure initializer result.

identity_choices.classification: new virtual ABI marker plus primary topology
identity_choices.rationale: Low83 is defined as this non-MTI virtual control ABI marker (source MTI cutoff2+1); it is not BAM-v1.7.4 silicon encoding. EE count2 comes from SM8250 DTS; every other feature field iszero/unimplemented.

identity_choices.classification: primary topology plus virtual width policy
identity_choices.rationale: Eight channels from SM8250 DTS; width code1 is the chosen nonzero36-bit encoding supported by the vendor decoder and descriptor high mask. Both non-pipe-group fields arezero, with no BAM-to-BAM/peer datapath.

An enabled reference instance has its modeled cold controller admitted and owns EE0 pipes4-7 from actual/public client pairs. Other pipes/EEs are outside this interface. Attribute bit31 describes this configured control state, not physical secure firmware or DMA readiness.
All IRQ masks startclear; every pipe startsidle with pending0. No global error/transfer producer exists. Cold client RMW endsata0; reset returnszero. No physical reset value claim.

policy.initial_remote_state_scope: Explicit virtual cold controller admission, EE0 ownership, and idle interrupt mask. No physical firmware result or measured reset state is claimed.
limitations: This policy permits testing of the virtual control ABI; it does not certify original physical state or full native cold-probe success.
The actual original crypto-manager binary was not compared; pinned public notest behavior is a separate source argument.
Original Android boot and userspace/UI remain incomplete.
required_model_boundaries: No descriptor fetch or guest-memory write
No crypto calculation, key acceptance, DMA transfer or successful completion
No asynchronous completion IRQ, error latch fabrication or caller patch
No DT/status/name rewrite to suppress a driver
Whole immutable profile and dynamic state validated before any post-load output
